predicts_ood.gate: Frozen formula predicts fresh rows at a declared boundary; report corpus/template cells and native ports.

extracted.gate: Standalone executable with explicit input ports, storage count, and isolated plus installed replay.
extracted.null: No behavioral null; port count and replay receipts are required.

selective.gate: Target effect survives removal or correction while at least three unrelated readers stay below the registered control ratio on fresh rows.

composes.gate: Möbius interaction below .35 of the smallest piece, joint effect predicted from singles, and every required subgroup present and passing.
composes.null: Equal-norm random splits of the same write.

simplicity_price.measure: Stored FP32 values, token table, native vector ports, intervention ports, derived caches, and suffix calls.
simplicity_price.current_coupled_operator: 16882563 stored FP32 values, 702 token IDs, native z8 and upstream delta external

promotion_rule: Do not call an object a circuit until all four behavioral properties pass at the declared scope; retain failed subgroup and null rows in the ledger. Simplicity is reported separately as a price.
